ingredients:
500g Ground Beef
1 onion, diced
2 cloves Garlic, minced
800g Canned Tomatoes
12 Lasagna Sheets
500ml Bechamel Sauce
200g Mozzarella cheese
50g Parmesan cheese
instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onions and garlic until translucent.
2. Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a wooden spoon.
3. Stir in canned tomatoes, salt, pepper, and herbs; simmer gently for 30 minutes.
4. Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F) and grease a rectangular baking dish.
5. Spread a layer of meat sauce on the bottom of the dish, followed by lasagna sheets and bechamel.
6. Repeat layers, finishing with bechamel sauce and topping generously with mozzarella and parmesan.
7. Bake in the oven for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling, then rest for 10 minutes before serving.
title: Classic Lasagna Bolognese

ingredients:
1.5kg Pork Roast with rind
2 tbsp Coarse Sea Salt
5 Bay Leaves
500ml Water
200ml Heavy Cream
1 tbsp Cornstarch
Red Cabbage for serving
instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F) and prepare a roasting pan with a wire rack.
2. Check that the pork rind is cut all the way through at narrow intervals without cutting into the meat.
3. Rub coarse sea salt thoroughly between all the rind slices and insert bay leaves.
4. Place the roast on the rack, pour water into the bottom of the pan, and roast for 1 hour 15 minutes.
5. Increase temperature to 225°C (435°F) for the last 15 minutes to crackle the rind.
6. Remove roast, rest for 15 minutes, and strain juices into a saucepan.
7. Simmer juices with heavy cream and cornstarch slurry to make a rich brown gravy.
title: Danish Flæskesteg (Roast Pork)

ingredients:
600g Chicken Thighs, cubed
150g Greek Yogurt
2 tbsp Garam Masala
1 tbsp Ginger Paste
1 Large Onion, chopped
400g Tomato Puree
200ml Heavy Cream
Fresh Cilantro
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken cubes in yogurt, half the garam masala, and ginger paste for 30 minutes.
2. Heat oil in a large skillet and sear chicken pieces until golden brown, then set aside.
3. Sauté chopped onions in the same skillet until caramelised and soft.
4. Add remaining spices and tomato puree; bring to a low simmer for 15 minutes.
5. Stir in heavy cream and return cooked chicken to the sauce.
6. Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes until chicken is tender and fully cooked through.
7. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot alongside basmati rice and warm naan.
title: Chicken Tikka Masala

ingredients:
500g Bread Flour
350ml Water
100g Active Sourdough Starter
10g Fine Sea Salt
Rice Flour for dusting
instructions:
1. Whisk sourdough starter into lukewarm water until dissolved in a mixing bowl.
2. Add bread flour and mix by hand until no dry flour remains; rest (autolyse) for 45 minutes.
3. Sprinkle sea salt over dough and stretch and fold to incorporate thoroughly.
4. Perform four sets of stretch and folds every 30 minutes during bulk fermentation.
5. Shape dough gently on a lightly floured work surface into a tight round boule.
6. Place shaped dough into a banneton basket dusted with rice flour; proof overnight in fridge.
7. Preheat Dutch oven to 250°C (480°F), score loaf top, and bake covered for 20 mins, then uncovered for 20 mins.
title: Sourdough Country Loaf

ingredients:
200g All-Purpose Flour
100g Cold Butter, cubed
3 tbsp Ice Water
150g Bacon, diced
1 Leek, sliced
4 Eggs
200ml Creme Fraiche
instructions:
1. Combine flour and cold butter in a bowl, rubbing until texture resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
2. Add ice water one tablespoon at a time until dough just holds together.
3. Roll out dough on floured surface and line a 23cm tart pan; chill in fridge for 30 minutes.
4. Blind bake crust with baking beans at 190°C (375°F) for 15 minutes.
5. Fry diced bacon and sliced leeks in a skillet until bacon is crisp and leeks are soft.
6. Whisk eggs and creme fraiche together; season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
7. Fill tart shell with bacon-leek mix, pour over egg custard, and bake for 30 minutes until set.
title: Danish Tærte (Savory Tart)

ingredients:
250g Flour
250g Sugar
3 Eggs
50g Butter
150ml Milk
2 tsp Baking Powder
150g Butter (Topping)
100g Coconut Flakes
200g Brown Sugar
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F) and line a 20x30cm cake tin with baking parchment.
2. Beat eggs and sugar in a bowl using a hand mixer until pale, thick, and fluffy.
3. Melt 50g butter in milk over low heat until warm but not hot.
4. Gently fold flour and baking powder into egg mixture alternating with warm milk mixture.
5. Pour batter into cake tin and bake for 20 minutes until cake is springy.
6. Melt topping butter, brown sugar, milk, and coconut flakes in a saucepan over medium heat.
7. Spread coconut topping evenly over hot cake and bake at 225°C (435°F) for 5 minutes until caramelized.
title: Classic Danish Drømmekage

ingredients:
500ml Heavy Cream
50g Sugar
1 Vanilla Bean, split
3 Gelatin Sheets
200g Fresh Raspberry Sauce
instructions:
1. Soak gelatin sheets in a bowl of cold water for 5 minutes until soft.
2. Combine heavy cream, sugar, and scraped vanilla bean seeds in a saucepan over medium heat.
3. Warm cream mixture until gentle heat is reached; do not allow to boil.
4. Squeeze excess water from gelatin sheets and whisk into warm cream until fully dissolved.
5. Strain liquid mixture through a fine sieve into individual ramekins or dessert glasses.
6. Cover with plastic wrap and chill in refrigerator for at least 4 hours until firm.
7. Top each chilled panna cotta with fresh raspberry sauce before serving cool.
title: Vanilla Bean Panna Cotta

ingredients:
400g Tagliatelle Pasta
200g Bacon, cubed
250g Cremini Mushrooms, sliced
2 cloves Garlic
250ml Heavy Cream
50g Grated Parmesan
Fresh Parsley
instructions:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook tagliatelle al dente.
2. Sauté cubed bacon in a deep skillet over medium heat until crispy.
3. Add sliced cremini mushrooms and garlic to skillet; cook until mushrooms turn golden brown.
4. Pour heavy cream into skillet, bring to a gentle simmer, and reduce heat.
5. Stir in grated parmesan cheese until sauce becomes smooth and glossy.
6. Transfer drained pasta directly into skillet and toss thoroughly to coat noodles.
7. Season with black pepper, garnish with chopped fresh parsley, and serve immediately.
title: Creamy Bacon & Mushroom Tagliatelle

ingredients:
400g Spaghetti
150g Guanciale or Pancetta
4 Large Egg Yolks
1 Whole Egg
100g Pecorino Romano cheese
Freshly Ground Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Bring a pot of water to boil with minimal salt and cook spaghetti until firm to bite.
2. Render sliced guanciale in a wide pan over medium heat until golden and crispy.
3. Whisk egg yolks, whole egg, and grated Pecorino Romano in a bowl with black pepper.
4. Remove pan with guanciale from heat and let cool slightly for 1 minute.
5. Transfer hot pasta to pan, pouring in 50ml starchy pasta water to halt cooking.
6. Immediately pour in egg-cheese mixture, tossing vigorously to create a silky emulsion.
7. Serve immediately with extra grated Pecorino and freshly cracked black pepper on top.
title: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara

ingredients:
4 Salmon Fillets
2 tbsp Butter
1 Lemon, juiced
150ml Heavy Cream
2 tbsp Fresh Dill
1 Garlic clove
Salt & Pepper
instructions:
1. Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
2. Heat butter in non-stick pan over medium-high.
3. Sear salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes.
4. Flip salmon and cook for another 3 minutes.
5. Remove salmon; sauté minced garlic in pan.
6. Stir in lemon juice, cream, and chopped dill.
7. Spoon sauce over salmon fillets to serve.
title: Sunday Seared Salmon with Lemon Dill Sauce

ingredients:
500g Flour
7g Yeast
250ml Milk
75g Sugar
100g Butter
2 tbsp Cinnamon
150g Cream Cheese (Glaze)
instructions:
1. Warm milk and mix with yeast and 1 tbsp sugar.
2. Combine flour, remaining sugar, melted butter, and yeast.
3. Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
4. Let rise in warm spot for 1 hour.
5. Roll dough into rectangle, spread butter, cinnamon, brown sugar.
6. Roll into log, slice into 12 rolls, place in dish.
7. Bake at 180°C for 25 mins; spread cream cheese glaze while warm.
title: Rustic Artisan Cinnamon Rolls

ingredients:
4 Egg Whites
220g Caster Sugar
1 tsp White Vinegar
1 tsp Cornflour
300ml Heavy Cream
200g Mixed Berries
2 Passionfruit
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 120°C (250°F) and line tray with parchment.
2. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
3. Add sugar gradually while beating until glossy stiff peaks form.
4. Fold in white vinegar and cornflour gently.
5. Shape meringue into 20cm disc on baking tray.
6. Bake for 1.5 hours, then turn off oven and let cool inside.
7. Top cooled meringue with whipped cream, berries, and passionfruit pulp.
title: Artisan Berry Pavlova with Passionfruit

ingredients:
400g Penne Pasta
1 Onion, diced
3 cloves Garlic
150g Tomato Paste
60ml Vodka
150ml Heavy Cream
Grated Parmesan
instructions:
1. Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
2. Sauté diced onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
3. Add tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes until darkened.
4. Pour in vodka and simmer until reduced by half.
5. Stir in heavy cream and simmer to smooth sauce.
6. Add pasta and 50ml pasta water to skillet.
7. Toss with parmesan cheese and fresh basil leaves.
title: Traditional Penne alla Vodka

ingredients:
200g Spanish Chorizo
800g Potatoes, cubed
1 Red Pepper
1 Onion
3 cloves Garlic
1 tsp Smoked Paprika
750ml Chicken Stock
instructions:
1. Slice chorizo and cook in pot until oil renders.
2. Sauté onion, garlic, and red pepper in chorizo oil.
3. Add smoked paprika and stir for 1 minute.
4. Add cubed potatoes and toss to coat.
5. Pour in chicken stock; bring to boil.
6. Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes until potatoes are soft.
7. Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread.
title: Gourmet Spanish Potato & Chorizo Stew

ingredients:
500g Flour
250ml Milk
75g Sugar
10g Fresh Cardamom, crushed
100g Butter
7g Yeast
Pearl Sugar for topping
instructions:
1. Scald milk with crushed cardamom; let cool.
2. Knead milk, flour, yeast, sugar, butter into smooth dough.
3. Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
4. Roll dough into rectangle, spread butter and cardamom sugar.
5. Fold dough into thirds and slice into strips.
6. Twist strips into knots and place on baking sheet.
7. Brush with egg, sprinkle pearl sugar, bake at 210°C for 12 mins.
title: Sunday Flaky Cardamom Buns

3 tbsp Sweet Paprika
400g Canned Tomatoes
500ml Beef Broth
2 Carrots
2 Potatoes
instructions:
1. Brown beef cubes in dutch oven with oil.
2. Sauté onions until soft and golden.
3. Stir in paprika, tomatoes, and beef broth.
4. Cover and simmer on low for 1.5 hours.
5. Add chopped carrots and potatoes.
6. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until tender.
7. Garnish with parsley and serve.
title: Traditional Traditional Beef Goulash

ingredients:
300g Rye Flour
150g Rye Kernels
100g Sunflower Seeds
50g Flaxseeds
400ml Sourdough Starter
1 tbsp Salt
350ml Dark Beer
instructions:
1. Soak rye kernels in dark beer overnight.
2. Mix soaked kernels with rye flour, seeds, salt, starter.
3. Stir vigorously until thick sticky dough forms.
4. Pack dough into greased loaf pan.
5. Cover and allow to rise for 4 to 6 hours.
6. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 1 hour 15 minutes.
7. Cool completely on wire rack for 24 hours before slicing.
title: Gourmet Danish Rye Bread (Rugbrød)

ingredients:
1 Whole Chicken
500g Baby Potatoes
3 Carrots
4 tbsp Olive Oil
2 tbsp Rosemary
1 tbsp Thyme
1 Garlic Head
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Chop potatoes and carrots into uniform chunks.
3. Pat chicken dry with paper towels.
4. Rub chicken and vegetables with olive oil, herbs, salt, and pepper.
5. Place in roasting pan with garlic head cut in half.
6. Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes until internal temp reaches 75°C.
7. Rest for 10 minutes before carving.
title: Artisan Roasted Herb Chicken with Vegetables

ingredients:
300g Whole Wheat Flour
200g White Bread Flour
375ml Water
7g Instant Yeast
10g Salt
1 tbsp Honey
1 tbsp Olive Oil
instructions:
1. Whisk flours, yeast, and salt together.
2. Add warm water, honey, and olive oil.
3. Mix until shaggy dough forms, then knead for 8 mins.
4. Let dough bulk ferment for 1.5 hours.
5. Shape into round boule on floured counter.
6. Proof in basket for 45 minutes.
7. Score top and bake at 220°C on baking stone for 35 mins.

2 Apples, sliced
1 Red Onion
2 tbsp Honey
1 tbsp Apple Cider Vinegar
2 tbsp Butter
Fresh Sage
instructions:
1. Season pork chops generously with salt.
2. Sear pork chops in heavy skillet for 5 mins per side.
3. Remove chops and set aside on plate.
4. Add sliced apples and onions to skillet.
5. Cook until tender, then add honey and vinegar.
6. Stir in fresh sage leaves and butter.
7. Serve pork chops topped with apple mixture.
title: Rustic Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Apples

ingredients:
500g Bread Flour
10g Salt
50g Sugar
10g Instant Yeast
300g Cold Butter for laminating
1 Egg for wash
140ml Cold Water
instructions:
1. Mix flour, salt, sugar, yeast, and cold water into dough.
2. Chill dough in fridge for 2 hours.
3. Beat cold butter into a flat square shape.
4. Enclose butter inside dough rectangle.
5. Perform 3 single turns with chilling in between.
6. Cut dough into triangles, roll into crescents.
7. Proof for 2 hours, brush with egg wash, bake at 200°C for 18 mins.

250ml Beef Stock

1 tbsp Dijon Mustard
Paprika
instructions:
1. Slice beef into thin strips.
2. Sear beef in hot skillet for 2 mins, then remove.
3. Sauté onions and mushrooms in same pan.
4. Deglaze pan with beef stock and simmer.
5. Stir in sour cream and Dijon mustard.
6. Return beef to pan and heat gently.
7. Serve over buttered egg noodles.

7. Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden.

7. Toss with parmesan cheese and fresh basil leaves.
title: Gourmet Penne alla Vodka Style

ingredients:
500g Ground Lamb
1 Onion, diced
200g Peas and Carrots
2 tbsp Tomato Paste
300ml Beef Stock
800g Potatoes
50g Butter
instructions:
1. Boil potatoes and mash with butter and milk.
2. Brown ground lamb in skillet with onions.
3. Add tomato paste, peas, carrots, and stock.
4. Simmer meat filling for 20 minutes until thick.
5. Transfer filling into baking dish.
6. Spread mashed potatoes evenly over top.
7. Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden.
title: Sunday Classic Shepherd's Pie

ingredients:
500g Flour
7g Yeast
250ml Milk
75g Sugar
100g Butter
2 tbsp Cinnamon
150g Cream Cheese (Glaze)
instructions:
1. Warm milk and mix with yeast and 1 tbsp sugar.
2. Combine flour, remaining sugar, melted butter, and yeast.
3. Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
4. Let rise in warm spot for 1 hour.
5. Roll dough into rectangle, spread butter, cinnamon, brown sugar.
6. Roll into log, slice into 12 rolls, place in dish.
7. Bake at 180°C for 25 mins; spread cream cheese glaze while warm.
title: Rustic Artisan Cinnamon Rolls Style

ingredients:
4 Egg Whites
220g Caster Sugar
1 tsp White Vinegar
1 tsp Cornflour
300ml Heavy Cream
200g Mixed Berries
2 Passionfruit
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 120°C (250°F) and line tray with parchment.
2. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
3. Add sugar gradually while beating until glossy stiff peaks form.
4. Fold in white vinegar and cornflour gently.
5. Shape meringue into 20cm disc on baking tray.
6. Bake for 1.5 hours, then turn off oven and let cool inside.
7. Top cooled meringue with whipped cream, berries, and passionfruit pulp.
title: Artisan Berry Pavlova with Passionfruit Style

ingredients:
400g Penne Pasta
1 Onion, diced
3 cloves Garlic
150g Tomato Paste
60ml Vodka
150ml Heavy Cream
Grated Parmesan
instructions:
1. Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
2. Sauté diced onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
3. Add tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes until darkened.
4. Pour in vodka and simmer until reduced by half.
5. Stir in heavy cream and simmer to smooth sauce.
6. Add pasta and 50ml pasta water to skillet.
7. Toss with parmesan cheese and fresh basil leaves.
title: Traditional Penne alla Vodka Style

ingredients:
4 Salmon Fillets
2 tbsp Butter
1 Lemon, juiced
150ml Heavy Cream
2 tbsp Fresh Dill
1 Garlic clove
Salt & Pepper
instructions:
1. Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
2. Heat butter in non-stick pan over medium-high.
3. Sear salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes.
4. Flip salmon and cook for another 3 minutes.
5. Remove salmon; sauté minced garlic in pan.
6. Stir in lemon juice, cream, and chopped dill.
7. Spoon sauce over salmon fillets to serve.
title: Gourmet Seared Salmon with Lemon Dill Sauce

ingredients:
500g Flour
250ml Milk
75g Sugar
10g Fresh Cardamom, crushed
100g Butter
7g Yeast
Pearl Sugar for topping
instructions:
1. Scald milk with crushed cardamom; let cool.
2. Knead milk, flour, yeast, sugar, butter into smooth dough.
3. Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
4. Roll dough into rectangle, spread butter and cardamom sugar.
5. Fold dough into thirds and slice into strips.
6. Twist strips into knots and place on baking sheet.
7. Brush with egg, sprinkle pearl sugar, bake at 210°C for 12 mins.
title: Sunday Flaky Cardamom Buns Style

ingredients:
200g Spanish Chorizo
800g Potatoes, cubed
1 Red Pepper
1 Onion
3 cloves Garlic
1 tsp Smoked Paprika
750ml Chicken Stock
instructions:
1. Slice chorizo and cook in pot until oil renders.
2. Sauté onion, garlic, and red pepper in chorizo oil.
3. Add smoked paprika and stir for 1 minute.
4. Add cubed potatoes and toss to coat.
5. Pour in chicken stock; bring to boil.
6. Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes until potatoes are soft.
7. Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread.
title: Traditional Spanish Potato & Chorizo Stew

ingredients:
300g Rye Flour
150g Rye Kernels
100g Sunflower Seeds
50g Flaxseeds
400ml Sourdough Starter
1 tbsp Salt
350ml Dark Beer
instructions:
1. Soak rye kernels in dark beer overnight.
2. Mix soaked kernels with rye flour, seeds, salt, starter.
3. Stir vigorously until thick sticky dough forms.
4. Pack dough into greased loaf pan.
5. Cover and allow to rise for 4 to 6 hours.
6. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 1 hour 15 minutes.
7. Cool completely on wire rack for 24 hours before slicing.
title: Gourmet Danish Rye Bread (Rugbrød) Style
